# Al Qaryan Industries LLC

> Plastic trading, recycling and PVC pipe manufacturing company in Karachi, Pakistan,
> established 2007. Imports virgin, off-grade and recycled polymers; processes around
> 500 tons per month at its own Shershah Industrial Area facility; buys plastic scrap
> nationwide and supplies manufacturers across Pakistan.

## What we do

- [Materials we deal](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/): 13 plastic scrap and
  polymer streams, with grades, specification and contamination notes for each
- [About the company](https://alqaryangroup.com/about/): history, ownership and facilities
- [Our facility](https://alqaryangroup.com/facility/): shredder, washing line, pelletiser
  and two PVC pipe extrusion lines
- [Quality and certifications](https://alqaryangroup.com/quality/): ISO 9001, ISO 14001,
  REACH, SGS inspection
- [We buy scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/we-buy/): what we purchase, and how to sell to us
- [Contact](https://alqaryangroup.com/contact/): enquiries, quotes and site clearances

## Materials

- [HDPE 100 pipe scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/hdpe-100-pipe-scrap/): PE100 pressure pipe scrap, MRS 10 MPa
- [HDPE 80 scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/hdpe-80-scrap/): PE80 pipe from water and irrigation networks
- [HDPE 60 scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/hdpe-60-scrap/): legacy PE63 pipe
- [PVC pipe scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/pvc-pipe-scrap/): rigid uPVC drainage, sewer and conduit
- [UPVC profile scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/upvc-profile-scrap/): window and door profile scrap
- [PVC cable scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/pvc-cable-scrap/): plasticised PVC from wire and cable
- [PET bottle scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/pet-bottle-scrap/): baled bottles and washed flake
- [PC bottle scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/pc-bottle-scrap/): polycarbonate water bottles
- [HDPE jerry can scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/hdpe-jerry-can-scrap/): blow-moulded containers
- [HDPE cable cover scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/hdpe-cable-cover-scrap/): cable covers, split duct and conduit
- [PP scrap](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/pp-scrap/): woven sacks, FIBC, crates and caps
- [Prime materials](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/prime-materials/): virgin polymer with full producer documentation
- [Off-grade materials](https://alqaryangroup.com/materials-we-deal/off-grade-materials/): wide-spec and off-spec polymer

## Company facts

- Legal name: Al Qaryan Industries LLC
- Established: 2007
- Location: Shershah Industrial Area, Karachi, Sindh 75700, Pakistan
- Processing capacity: approximately 500 tons of plastic per month
- Equipment: shredder, washing and drying line, pelletiser with filtration, two PVC pipe
  extrusion lines
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, REACH; SGS inspection available on request
- Import origins: Japan, USA, Canada, Malaysia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Indonesia
- Markets served: nationwide across Pakistan; container lots for export enquiries
- Phone: +92 333 201 0506
- Email: info@alqaryangroup.com
